remarks: Welcome to this beautifully maintained tri-level townhouse in the sought-after Green Oaks complex. This spacious 2-bedroom, 1.5-bath home offers an open-concept main level with hardwood floors, crown molding, and a bright living room that flows into the dining area-perfect for entertaining. The kitchen features ample cabinet space, solid countertops, and easy access to your private patio, where you can grill and relax just steps from the community pool. Upstairs, you'll find two generously sized bedrooms, including a primary suite with a walk-in closet and a second bedroom with excellent closet space. The renovated bathrooms add a modern touch, including a stylish full bath with a glass-enclosed shower and sleek finishes. The finished lower level offers flexible living space with direct access to your private garage. Enjoy the unbeatable location close to grocery stores, Home Depot, I-95, and just minutes to the charm of Old Greenwich. This home combines comfort, convenience, and a low-maintenance lifestyle in a desirable community.
